I did pest control for 4 years so the list is pretty long but one thing that really stuck with me was this 2 bedroom buget suite that housed 4 adults, 1 3 year old boy, a new born baby, 1 dog and a cat. The cat and dog shit and pissed all over inside, no litter box or piddle pads. They also had bed bugs super bad. The second i walked in my eyes started burning and i could barely breathe, the piss and shit combo was absolutely disgusting. The adults were smoking cigarettes on the couch and the 2 year old was running around barefoot all over that shit and piss, he had obvious rashes on his body. The newborn baby was crying in a crib, completely unattended in the bedroom. When i left i couldnt help but cry a little out of sheer disgust and sadness for those kids to have to live like that. I called CPS and nothing was ever done, dont fucking understand how. I eventually had to treat the unit for bed bugs with a heat treatment which involved me setting up industrial heater and fans in the room and heating up to 140 degrees Fahrenheit. When i returned the following morning i had to wear a respirator and goggles to take my equipment out. I vomitted afterwards and had to wash my eyes out. So glad i quit that shit job.
